create_named_context: create a NamedContext to store and manage named data variables in a data pipeline
build_transform_pipeline: build a Compose transform to apply multiple transforms sequentially to data items
create_lambda_transform: create a Lambda transform to apply a function to NamedContext variables with @-prefixed references
test_stochastic_transform: test a Stochastic transform to apply another transform with a given probability
review_tuple_transform: review the Tuple transform to combine multiple NamedContext variables into a tuple
